Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: That sounds like une vie difficile. I can't begin to imagine what it is like to be there.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: The only thing you have to survive in France is notre politique, but somehow I feel like this is not what you meant !

Line.Text: Ah, home. Sometimes it really fails to set you up for a good life.
